query: select jsonb_build_object('indexes',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',ic.relname,'unique',i.indisunique,'valid',i.indisvalid,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) order by c.relname,ic.relname) from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid=i.indrelid join pg_class ic on ic.oid=i.indexrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname ~ '^bobby_(brief|push_|coupon|usage_bonus|user_|reads$|level_uses$|admin_grant)'),'changelogAffectedIndexCount',(select count(*) from pg_index idx join pg_class ic on idx.indexrelid=ic.oid join pg_namespace n on ic.relnamespace=n.oid join pg_am am on am.oid=ic.relam join lateral unnest(idx.indclass::oid[]) with ordinality as k(opclass,pos) on true join pg_opclass oc on oc.oid=k.opclass join pg_type ty on ty.oid=oc.opcintype where n.nspname='public' and k.pos<=idx.indnkeyatts and (ty.typname in ('ltree','_ltree') or (am.amname='gist' and ty.typname in ('float4','float8')))),'publicFunctionsUsingLegacyPGP',(select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.prosrc ~* 'pgp_(sym|pub)_encrypt' and p.prosrc ~* 'cipher-algo=(bf|blowfish|cast5)'),'sequencePrivileges',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sequence',c.relname,'anon_usage',has_sequence_privilege('anon',c.oid,'USAGE'),'authenticated_usage',has_sequence_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'USAGE'),'service_usage',has_sequence_privilege('service_role',c.oid,'USAGE'))) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='S' and c.relname='bobby_coupon_redemptions_id_seq')) as metadata;
